en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are tightly packed multi‑story townhouses and industrial buildings with tiled roofs and a tall factory chimney. Behind them are clusters of trees and scattered houses leading up to open fields divided into rectangular plots. On the right side stands a prominent neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire and adjoining large buildings that resemble a rectory or school. Rolling wooded hills form the background, with farmsteads and country roads visible across the landscape. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
